instruction: Configure VLC so that double-clicking video files reuses the existing window instead of opening a new one each time.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the 'one instance when started from file' option in VLC (one-instance-when-started-from-file=1). The evaluator uses the existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file function which reads the VLC config file and verifies that this setting is enabled. This is similar in difficulty to the original task - both involve changing a single VLC behavior preference.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads VLC configuration file (vlcrc) which is the appropriate source for this setting
Metric function correctly checks the 'one-instance-when-started-from-file' setting in the config file
Expected value of 1 correctly represents enabling the single-instance mode, which matches the instruction requirement to reuse existing instance
Evaluator provides complete coverage - instruction requires configuring a single VLC setting, and evaluator checks exactly that setting
Metric parameter handling is correct - directly accesses rule['expected_one_instance_when_started_from_file'] without incorrect nesting
No UI state dependency - config file can be read directly after task completion
Postconfig appropriately restarts VLC to ensure settings are persisted
